title: Learning to Think with Images Faithfully via Adaptive Data Selection
title_zh: 通过自适应数据选择学习忠实的图像辅助推理
abstract_en: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.
abstract_zh: 图像辅助推理（Thinking with Images, TwI）让视觉语言模型（VLMs）主动裁剪并放大局部区域，以识别整图中难以看清的细节。然而，准确率提升并不意味着模型真正依赖工具返回的证据：模型经常调用放大工具，却不依据放大区域作答。作者将这一问题追溯到训练数据：如果问题无需放大即可答对，模型就能忽略局部证据；随着模型无工具作答能力的提升，这一问题会进一步加剧。为此，作者根据模型在训练中的能力变化动态筛选样本，保留那些仍能从正确的放大证据中受益的问题。方法还通过数据合成流程定位小物体、构造关于细节的可验证问题，并使用自适应奖励（adaptiveness reward），鼓励模型在无需放大时直接作答。实验表明，该方法显著提高了推理忠实性，并在视觉搜索基准上达到最先进水平（V*：+11.6%，HR-Bench 4K：+7.9%，HR-Bench 8K：+9.4%），在多模态幻觉基准上也优于所比较的 TwI 基线。结果表明，无需直接监督推理过程，选择合适的训练数据也能同时改善忠实性与准确率。
key_points_zh: 调用放大工具不等于使用局部证据：模型即使答对，也可能完全忽略放大区域。
随着模型越来越擅长直接作答，原本需要放大的样本可能失去训练价值，因此要随模型能力变化动态筛选问题。
数据合成流程围绕小物体的细节构造可验证问题；自适应奖励鼓励模型在放大无益时直接作答。
无需直接监督推理过程即可提升忠实性；V*、HR-Bench 4K 和 HR-Bench 8K 的性能分别提升 11.6%、7.9% 和 9.4%，多模态幻觉基准表现也优于所比较的 TwI 基线。
